lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers and scams. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: Each line is separate, with a clear 0.8-second pause between lines. Hook lines: punchy, intriguing, like a TV show host. Countdown: slow and dramatic. Reveal lines: weighty. Rule lines: firm, useful advice. Last lines: dry, cocky call to action.

seryoga.profile: Seryoga — a naive, kind young Russian guy in his 20s who buys a used car; eager, a bit gullible, but learns fast. Bright, quick voice.
seryoga.notes: Each line is separate, with a clear 1-second pause between lines. Curious, eager to learn, then happy and impressed. In the guessing game: confident, then surprised and self-ironic. In the dealership: naive and hesitant.

vika.profile: Vika — a sharp, confident young Russian woman in her 20s, street-smart, ironic, protective friend. Clear, firm voice with a smirk.
vika.notes: Each line is separate, with a clear 1-second pause between lines. Confident, calm, sharp, slightly sarcastic, she knows her rights.

mihalych.profile: Mihalych — an old, experienced Russian car mechanic in his 60s, gruff, calm, a bit tired, speaks like a master who has seen everything. Low husky voice.
mihalych.notes: Each line is separate, with a clear 1-second pause between lines. Unhurried, calm, a master teaching a young guy, a bit of dry humor.

tolyan.profile: Tolyan — a cocky Russian used-car flipper (perekup) in his 30s, street swagger, deep raspy voice, show-off, calls everyone "брат". Adult street comedy, not for kids.
tolyan.notes: Each line is separate, with a clear 1-second pause between lines. Annoyed, rushing out of a garage, swearing at his accomplice. Wherever the word "блин" appears, say it sharply and clearly as a curse (it will be bleeped).

galya.profile: Baba Galya — a sly Russian grandmother in her 70s selling a car from a garage; sweet, folksy voice, calls everyone «сынок» and «милок», but she is in on a scam. Warm, slightly cracked old voice.
galya.notes: Each line is separate, with a clear 1-second pause between lines. Line 1: sweet, convincing, folksy. Line 2: innocent, a bit caught. Line 3: panicked, calling loudly for help.

edik.profile: Edik — a slick, fast-talking Russian car dealership manager in his 30s, overly polite, pushy, fake-friendly smile in the voice, sales script energy.
edik.notes: Each line is separate, with a clear 1-second pause between lines. Line 1: cheerful, pushy upsell. Line 2: slightly offended, insisting. Line 3: desperate last attempt, overly sweet.
